title: Bitter Divorce
summary: Use an Action up to 30 ft away to raise Connor Vinderblad as a zombie.

fields.Base value: 100 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Act One with Mayrina: If the party keeps the wand after raising Connor with Mayrina present, it becomes Second Marriage.
fields.Act One without Mayrina: Connor rises hostile. The wand stays Bitter Divorce and does not grant a summon.
fields.Act Three from Mayrina: Connor rises as an ally if the wand was bought or pickpocketed from Mayrina in Act Three. The wand stays Bitter Divorce and does not grant a summon.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Separated the three quest outcomes.
